plugins.name: swift-skills
plugins.description: Four skills for Swift/iOS development: Foundation Models (complete guide with API reference, anti-patterns, and diagnostics), SwiftData persistence, accessibility diagnostics, and structured logging patterns. Includes a hook for Swift pattern enforcement (blocks deprecated APIs). SwiftUI is covered by Apple's official Xcode 27 agent skills.
